purpose: scores_sha256 of the compose-demo-normal/1 test split per numerical environment; data and test metrics are compared with evaluation.json

historical.source: evaluation.json, test evaluated once after protocol commit 8fb49e5

discrepancy.reported: A retraining of the same code produced scores_sha256 210f256d58512f5def1ca6044368c30cb97462a5f970f9d8691920396a9b7324 with equal data hashes and metrics; the environment and SIMD level of that run were not recorded.
discrepancy.cause: NumPy runtime CPU dispatch. Disabling the X86_V4 (AVX-512) level on an AVX-512 host reproduces that hash; the fitted model does not depend on the level.

evidence.fitted_parameters_equal_x86_v4_vs_x86_v3: scaler mean_/scale_, offset_, estimators_features_ and feature/threshold/children/n_node_samples of all 100 trees: 604 comparisons equal
evidence.cross_scoring: model trained at X86_V3 scored at X86_V4 gives the historical hash; model trained at X86_V4 scored at X86_V3 gives 210f256d...

conditions.host: VDS2 Linux x86-64 with AVX-512; lower levels via NPY_DISABLE_CPU_FEATURES, not on physical hosts without AVX-512
conditions.code: PR #41 HEAD 1076d63b7f6dce17835c3e24746a80df9782f5e6 plus the environment.numpy_simd field; generators, model and threshold unchanged
not_verified: Python 3.12 patch releases other than 3.12.3 in this rework
